reference: Independent copied PhysX-cooked vertices/triangles, mesh-to-body transforms, actual nine-DOF feedback and actual rigid-body poses. Preserve all eleven bodies including mounted base, hand and both fingers.

requested_posture_capture.motion_strategy: Existing direct strategy; original tolerances and physical parameters
requested_posture_capture.failure_policy: Retain failures and measured states. A phase declares the requested target; actual TCP and operation outcomes determine whether it was achieved. Do not retune a failed target or invent a low-reaching state from old higher configurations.

other_recorded_inputs: Historical V4.1 acceptance cycles generation0, including actual startup Home
Historical V4.1 static/narrow/large seed123456 actual near-obstacle routes
New frozen HomeDetour outward/return native trajectories when available
selection: First, middle and last distinct physics-step/time observations within each declared phase; phase-free historical routes use the same deterministic selection. Keep original indices, q, TCP, physics time and source artifact hashes.

surface_measurement.quadrature: 64 equal-area triangle-subdivision centroids per copied cooked triangle
surface_measurement.coverage: Area-weighted fraction of actual surface samples inside the full native planning-sphere union
surface_measurement.maximum_gap: Maximum positive sample-to-sphere-union distance, reported per body and across selected actual postures
surface_measurement.interpretation: Sampled surface coverage and sampled maximum outside gaps are numerical estimates, separate from the source-bound finite convex-cell solid-containment certificate.

frame_measurement: Compare native URDF FK with actual body poses. For fingers report nominal fixed-descriptor mismatch separately, then correct FK using measured independent finger positions and URDF prismatic axes before measuring alignment.
configuration_measurement: Check stock/enhanced external collision and existing URDF fixed/adjacent self exclusions. Enhanced additionally permits only the analytically separated finger pair. Retain finger/link6 checks. Compare obstructed configurations with independently measured actual cooked-solid box/plane clearance before calling them conservative false obstructions.
base_interpretation: Native base sphere-union gaps remain visible. Separately report the conservative frozen-base enclosing-sphere/AABB preflight; its containment is source/frame conditional, and its exact support-plane AABB is not inflated below the nominal mount.

cpu_query_timing.default: NOT_MEASURED until explicitly run on a quiescent machine
cpu_query_timing.interpretation: Repeated same-q native CPU query timings include Python/caching overhead and exclude RRT, trajectory generation and Kit stalls. Native planner/execution timing is measured separately.

claims: Missing captures and timings remain unmeasured. No future execution, tracking-error, contact-offset, continuous-motion or all-world safety guarantee follows from this audit.
